raw_response:
I am a man of 42 years here in Dedza, and I never went to school. This small piece of land, only a bit bigger than my house yard, I will plant with beans like my father did. I have no money to buy fertilizer from the shop — beans anyway put life back into the soil, so I will just put the manure from my few chickens and goats where I can. I will use the seeds I kept from last harvest, and my wife and older children will help me weed. The rains will water the plot; I have no way to bring water here, and I cannot pay anyone to work for me.
